uncited: - Input: The pair stream $P$ and its sidecars (flat-id, geometry) after Tile-Local Bin Construction, along with bin offset arrays `binOffsets[t, b]` for tile $t$ and bin $b$.
- Output: A repaired pair stream where selected segments are sorted by the original baseline key $s(e)$, with sidecars aligned.
- Local exact-repair maximum: 512 entries
- Always-keep long segment cutoff: $l \ge 320$
- Tile-share cutoff: $l / l_{\text{tile}} \ge 45\%$
- Local-256 share cutoff: $129 \le l \le 256$ AND $l / l_{\text{tile}} \ge 10\%$
- Early bin repair: $b < 2$ AND $l \ge 16$
Initialize $R = \emptyset$ and $\text{used} = 0$.
Iterate over logical segment IDs $q = t \times K + b$ in tile-bin order.
Get $\text{begin} = \text{binOffsets}[t, b]$ and $\text{end} = \text{binOffsets}[t, b+1]$.
Calculate length $l = \text{end} - \text{begin}$.
Calculate $l_{\text{tile}} = \text{binOffsets}[t, K] - \text{binOffsets}[t, 0]$.
If $129 \le l \le 256$ AND $l / l_{\text{tile}} \ge 0.10$, set $\text{keep} = \text{true}$.
If $b < 2$ AND $l \ge 16$, set $\text{keep} = \text{true}$.
If $\text{keep}$ is true AND $\text{used} + l \le B_{\text{rep}}$, add $(t, b, \text{begin}, \text{end})$ to $R$ and update $\text{used} = \text{used} + l$.
Sort $P[\text{begin}:\text{end})$ by original baseline key $s(e)$.
Keep flat-id and geometry sidecars aligned with the sorted pair order.
Return repaired pair stream and aligned sidecars.
- Time Complexity: Sorting is performed only on selected segments.
The cost is $O(\sum_{s \in R} l_s \log l_s)$, where $l_s$ is the length of segment $s$.
- Memory Complexity: $O(N)$ for the pair stream and sidecars, plus $O(|R|)$ for the repair list.
It is part of the TileGS rasterization pipeline for Gaussian Splatting.
